name: Mesubuta no Rakuin ~ Kachiku Choukyou Sareta Tsuma no Matsuro
original_name: 牝豚の烙印～家畜調教された妻の末路
source:
When Hiroko Blackwater is expelled from school she takes revenge on her teacher's wife, Mayumi Kitahara, while Mr. Kitahara is in hospital. Bowel evacuation! Public exposure!

"Please stop... it's too humiliating!... I can't... Please, don't do... nooooo! NOOOOO!
Oh my god my sh*thole is about to burst! It's all coming out Here it comessss!!"

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE154342.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“当黑水博子被学校开除时，她向老师的妻子北原真由美报仇，而北原先生住院了。排便！公众暴露！

“请停下来……这太丢脸了！……我不能……求求你，不要这样做……不不不不！不不不不！”
天啊我的屁眼快要爆了！一切都出来了，它来了！！”
